native_rules: V2 dispatcher routes method ngram to NgramGPUSpeculator
scan score encodes n*(max_model_len+1)+position+1; maximum selects longest then rightmost match
missing proposal slots use last sampled token and are verified as ordinary drafts
replay_rules: longest n-gram then most recent match
proposal length can be shorter than K and can be zero
other_differences: server chat-template and control tokens differ from text retokenization
combined replay adds two newlines between thinking and answer
replay includes its first output token; native decode excludes prefill
multi-turn exported prompts flatten earlier conversation history
counter_validation: fresh full plain run plus existing Triton MTP control; no preemptions; emitted_steps equals completion tokens for plain and drafts+1 for MTP
